about: Golden vectors for Home's layout core (com.gpo.yoin.shared.home, parity p4; Android PR #250 / #292): the stored document (codec: unknown document and entry keys kept, a malformed entry drops alone, a non-object wide reads as none), reconcile (retired ids dropped, unknown ids retained, first occurrence wins, appended sections and WideDefault pairs for free partners), every edit (changed false = the same layout back: no Undo step), the defaults and the persist rule, the pair helpers, the feed rows, the unit rules and the edit session's draft / echo / step rules. Generated from :shared Kotlin through YoinHomeLayout by HomeLayoutGoldenTest (androidHostTest); do not edit by hand. Every vector is its inputs followed by the answer. A state is either a name from "states" or a state object: sections in render order (id, enabled, then only what differs from the defaults: rows key (default l), rowsSet, half, units, configExtras, entryExtras), then retained entries, newSections, widePairs ([left, right]), retainedWide and retainedDocument when present. ops / editStep answer {changed, after}; after is left out when nothing changed.
